title: Sydney Opera House Forecourt — free ticketed 31 December 2026 event

facts.fact: The Forecourt event is dated 31 December 2026; bookings are essential and entry is not available without a ticket.
facts.excerpt: New Year’s Eve on the Opera House Forecourt is a free ticketed event and bookings are essential. A ticket guarantees your entry. You won’t be able to access the Forecourt without a ticket.
facts.location: Plan your visit, free Forecourt conditions

facts.fact: The operator announces booking release at 10am on 26 December, with at most six tickets per booking; no present-day availability is inferred.
facts.excerpt: Bookings open 10am on 26 December. There is a limit of six tickets per booking.
facts.location: Event introduction. Footer says Friday 26 December 2026 although calendar gives Saturday; weekday is omitted rather than copied.

facts.fact: Forecourt admission is fromnoon to 3pm on 31 December 2026, via Macquarie Street only; this differs from paid-event entry hours.
facts.excerpt: Access for Forecourt ticket holders is between 12 midday and 3pm on Thursday 31 December 2026. No entry will be permitted for Public Forecourt ticket holders after 3pm.

facts.fact: Food, beverages and glass may not be brought in; an empty water bottle is permitted subject to material/size rules and on-site water stations.
facts.excerpt: Empty water bottles are allowed (no metal or glass, and no larger than 1 litre) – free water stations are available on the Forecourt. No BYO alcohol, beverages, food or glass.

facts.fact: Registration for the dedicated accessible Forecourt viewing area closed at the end of October 2026; ordinary admission must not be presented as that registration.
facts.excerpt: Registrations for this dedicated area closed at the end of October 2026.

notes: Official document actually captured and read on the recorded date. Raw HTML and extracted text are preserved outside Git in artifacts/maletafeliz-new-year-ten-n 12/sources-asia-london/research. The article distinguishes 31 December 2026 from 1 January 2027, current announcements from historical copy, and public places from ticketed events. Archive photographs identify places only and do not document the future celebration. No purchase, availability guarantee, personal experience or search-demand claim is made.
